title: 20x20 Houston Map Art — 3D Printed Framed City Map
description: A modern take on the classic Houston map. Every street, bay and freeway of the greater Houston area is 3D printed as a raised relief and mounted behind glass in a natural wood frame, so the city reads as a piece of topography rather than a flat print. The downtown skyscrapers stand proud of the street grid, and the print is finished by hand in our Houston studio. 20in x 20in, framed and ready to hang.
fulfilment: Made to order in our Houston studio. Local pickup in Sugar Land, TX (77479).

title: Praying Hands 20in Diameter Moss LED Art Wall Lamp
description: Turn a blank wall into a sanctuary. This handcrafted sculptural lamp pairs the vibrant organic texture of premium preserved moss with a minimalist magnetic LED light, and centres a pair of praying hands in white resin. The round black frame reads like a gallery piece while the warm LED ring lights the moss from within, so the relief and the hands cast their own soft shadows. Made to order, 20in x 20in, and finished by hand in our Houston studio.
fulfilment: Made to order in our Houston studio. Local pickup in Sugar Land, TX (77479).
